links.outcome: Pathology encoder similarity ranking across institutions versus within institution
links.effect: Pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles; scaling training data does not resolve it. LLMs appear less susceptible.
links.quote: find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations.

unlisted_practices: Use relative cross-domain similarity benchmark (MOSAIC) to detect institution-shortcut failures in pathology models
Consider multimodal LLMs as alternative to pathology foundation models for cross-institutional retrieval

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study (MOSAIC benchmark) assessing cross-domain histological similarity and domain shortcut robustness of multimodal LLMs versus specialized pathology foundation models.
